name: Masked Identity, Greater
body:
You become a more talented masked vigilante.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 9th, Improved Masked Identity.

Benefit(s): You gain a vigilante talent, treating your character level as half of your vigilante level for the purposes of which vigilante level you can select with this feat, but for the purpose of the vigilante talent’s effect, your effective vigilante level is equal to your full character level. At 16th and 20th level, you can change your vigilante talent to a new one for which you qualify.
